paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
heading: Milim Biakna Mohpaihna
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel tang lam nga inla, akiang uah thu gen inla,
english: “Son of man, set your face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy to them,

paite: Israel tangte aw, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN in tangte leh mualte kiang ah, leh phaizangte leh kuamte kiang ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in na tung uah namsau ka hon lik ding a, na mun sangte uh ka hihse vek ding.
english: and say, ‘You mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! The Lord Yahweh says to the mountains and to the hills, to the watercourses and to the valleys: “Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword on you, and I will destroy your high places.

paite: Na maitamte uh loihsan in a-om ding a, na ni pathian limte uh akitamzan ding; na mithah luangte uh na milimte uh ma ah ka pai ding hi.
english: Your altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

paite: Amilimte uh ma ah Israel suante luang ka koihkhawm ding a, na guhte uh na maitam kim uah ka thehzak ding hi.
english: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

paite: Na tenna mun tengteng uah khopi ase ding a, mun sangte akisegawp ding; na maitamte uh hihsiat leh loihsan ahihtheihna ding un leh na milimte uh akitapnen a, aman theihna ding in leh na ni pathian limte uh phukpaih a a-omtheihna ding un, na nasepte uh aman theihna ding in.
english: In all your dwelling places, the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be desolate, so that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your incense altars may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

paite: Huan na lak uah mithahte apuk ding ua, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh.
english: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.

paite: "Himahleh gam chih a na dalhzak hun chiang un namte lak ah namsau a suakta a-om ding ziak un akhen ka hon hawi ding.
english: “‘“Yet I will leave a remnant, in that you will have some that escape the sword among the nations, when you are scattered through the countries.

paite: Huan na lak ua kipan a pawtte'n sal a apina namte uh lak ah kei ahon theigige ding ua, a-angkawmna lungtang uh ka lakmang sakleh amit uh, amilim lam ua angkawmte ka hihsiat sakdante athei ding uh; thil gilou a na hih ziak uleh akihhuai ziak un amau mitmuh ngei in leng kihhuai akisa ding uh.
english: Those of you that escape will remember me among the nations where they are carried captive, how I have been broken with their lewd heart, which has departed from me, and with their eyes, which play the prostitute after their idols. Then they will loathe themselves in their own sight for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding ua, hiai thil hoih lou akiang uah ka hih ding a, amawk in ka chi kei chih athei ding uh, chi in," achi hi.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.”’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na khut beng in na khe pek inla, Maizen! Israel inkote kihhuaina gitlouh ziak maw! Namsau in, kial in, hipi in apuk ding uhi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Strike with your hand, and stamp with your foot, and say, “Alas!”, because of all the evil abominations of the house of Israel; for they will fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

paite: Gamlapi a om hipi in asi ding ua, anai a om namsau in apuk ding ua, aval, um a omte kial in asi ding uh; hichibang in ka hehna mahmah atung uah ka bukimsak ding hi.
english: He who is far off will die of the pestilence. He who is near will fall by the sword. He who remains and is besieged will die by the famine. Thus I will accomplish my wrath on them.

paite: Mual sang teng ah, tang vumte ah leh sing hing peuhmah nuai ah leh tosaw bawkpha chih nuai a amilimte uh kiang a gimlim alatna mun ua amaitam kim ua amilimte uh lak a amisi luangte uh a-om hun chiang in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh.
english: You will know that I am Yahweh when their slain men are among their idols around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every green tree, and under every thick oak—the places where they offered pleasant aroma to all their idols.

paite: Atung uah ka khut ka lik ding a, gamdai a kipan Diblah lam a atenna mun tengteng uh gamsia suaksak in ka loihsan vek ding; huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
english: I will stretch out my hand on them and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout all their habitations. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
